features.name: Pack skills leave the global install and are linked into the repos that list them
features.description: T15 (T10's second half) of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-17-two-layer-harness-design.md, decisions D7 and D10. install.sh installs every skill as before, then `harness_adapter.py store-packs` moves the skills of every pack but core out of each agent's global skills dir into <runtime>/pack-skills/<agent>/. sync links the packs a repo's agent-harness.json lists into its .claude/skills (claude), .agents/skills (agy, codex) and .kiro/skills, from that agent's stored copy or any other agent's; unlinks packs it no longer lists; never replaces a repo's own skill of the same name; and lists the links in a marked block of .git/info/exclude, since they point at this host. infra moved into core: its skills are host tools whose instructions call ~/.claude/skills/infra/... . hangar lists tracking, atelier ai and frontend; spec-gated is company-only. Also fixed: install.sh wrote kiro's agent config before installing skills, so it always listed the previous install's skills (none on a first install).
acceptance_criteria: store-packs moves only pack skills (links as links, dirs as dirs) and can run again after the next install
sync links listed packs for every agent dir, unlinks dropped ones, keeps a repo's own skill and keeps links out of git
live: a pack skill loads in its repo and not elsewhere, for claude and agy; a spec-gated skill is no longer global
kiro's agent config lists the installed skills, none of the moved ones
all 11 harness gates pass, with gate output saved to a file
features.verification: python3 -m pytest tests/test_harness_adapter.py -q && bash scripts/tests/test_install_source_guard.sh && bash scripts/harness-verify.sh
features.evidence: Tests first: 3 new adapter tests failed (no store-packs or linking), 39 passed after; test_install_source_guard.sh kiro case failed on the old install order and passes after. Two tests used pack skills as samples (infra as a valid pack, apidog as an installed local skill); now tracking and spec-workflow. Live probe before building: a skill in <repo>/.claude/skills and .agents/skills loads for claude (-p, haiku) and agy when the session starts in the repo, and not from its parent folder. After install.sh --agent all and sync-all: 17 pack skills moved out of ~/.claude/skills, ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills, ~/.codex/skills and ~/.kiro/skills (global entries 35 -> 18); hangar links kanban-ai and linear, atelier ai-stack and webapp-testing, for all three agent dirs, git status clean. Live: claude in hangar sees linear (YES), from ~/projects not (NO), jira from ~/projects NO; agy in atelier sees ai-stack (YES), in hangar NO. kiro default.json: 18 resources, no moved skill. repo_audit 2026-10-18: hangar skills 34 -> 19, skill-description tokens 2380 -> 1158, always-loaded 5389 -> 4167; atelier 34 -> 19, 2380 -> 1151, 5014 -> 3785. Known limits: a session started outside a repo (e.g. ~/projects) gets no pack skills; uninstall.sh leaves <runtime>/pack-skills and the repo links in place; codex not live-tested.
